items.explanation: Lubić takes the accusative; "her" is ją.
optionNotes: Jej is the genitive or dative, used after nie: Nie lubię jej.
Nią is the instrumental after a preposition: z nią.

items.explanation: After a preposition he / him takes the n- form; dla + genitive: dla niego.
optionNotes: Go is never used after a preposition.
Jego is the long form without a preposition (and also means "his").
Nim is the instrumental or locative: z nim, o nim.

items.explanation: Z meaning "with" takes the instrumental: z nami.
optionNotes: Nas is the genitive, accusative or locative.

items.explanation: The person who gets something is in the dative: jej (to her).
optionNotes: Ją is the accusative (the object); the flowers are the object here.
Nią is the instrumental after a preposition.
Niej is used only after a preposition.
